subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.

Recumbent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Prostrate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Recumbent"** means lying down in a position of comfort or rest; reclining. (विश्राम की स्थिति में लेटा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **She was recumbent on the sofa, reading a book.
 
 
 
• **"Prostrate" **refers to lying flat on the ground, often face down, especially in submission or adoration. (साष्टांग लेटा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **He lay prostrate before the altar, praying fervently.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'recumbent' **is **'prostrate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Prostrate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Upstanding **(ईमानदार): Honest and respectable.

 
 
• **Example:** He is known as an upstanding member of the community.
 
 
 
• **Upright **(सीधा): Vertical; erect or honest and morally correct.
 
 
• **Example: **She sat upright in her chair during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Review** (समीक्षा): To examine or assess something formally with the possibility or intention of instituting change if necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee will review the proposal next week.
